citations.label: OpenAI, A thousand fewer paths to root
citations.excerpt: Our prototype identified and analyzed 2,308 candidate Linux kernel findings, dynamically reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities, and produced 948 local privilege escalation (LPE) exploits that could allow an unprivileged local user to gain root access.

citations.label: OpenAI, A thousand fewer paths to root
citations.excerpt: For the near and medium term, having access to a low-privileged account on an operating system, that isn’t up-to-date on its latest available patches should be considered functionally equivalent to root access for a well-resourced threat actor.

citations.label: OpenAI, A thousand fewer paths to root

citations.label: OpenAI, A thousand fewer paths to root

citations.excerpt: In the first attack, memory from the host, the machine your sandbox shares with other tenants, shows up in packets the guest sends over the internet. This can happen continuously, for as long as the guest keeps sending.  This attack was demonstrated against Vercel production sandboxes.
